# vibeoncall Provider

Manage Vibe OnCall configuration through the Vibe OnCall public API.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    vibeoncall = {
      source = "vibraniumlabs/vibeoncall"
    }
  }
}

# Reads the API key from VIBEONCALL_API_KEY when api_key is not set.
provider "vibeoncall" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Vibe OnCall API key. Defaults to the `VIBEONCALL_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `base_url` (String) Public API base URL. Defaults to `VIBEONCALL_BASE_URL`, then https://api-prod.vibraniumlabs.ai/api/v1.
